meta.summary: macOS Automator workflow on selected text stopped working in Firefox 111.0 release

comments.text:
Created attachment 9323506
Screenshot 2023-03-16 at 17.23.04.png

Steps to reproduce:

I use automator workflow in macOS which translates selected text. It stopped working on Firefox v111.0


Actual results:

I get error message saying that service could not be used 


Expected results:

Selected text should be supplied to automator workflow. Workflow opens Safari popup window with selected text

I'm experiencing the same issue. My automator actions start by capturing a highlighted URL. For some time now with Firefox, this actually required highlighting the URL twice before automator could be invoked. Now, automator can be invoked immediately, but fails with "there was a problem with input to the service." Automator tasks have always worked and continue to work in other browsers, which also didn't have the earlier requirement of highlighting the URL twice.
